div.h1: CHASM Activity: Cache Key Usage and Memory vs Persistence Lookups
div.p: RunID="" keys are sentinel/lock slots. RunID=uuid keys hold real WorkflowContext + MutableState.
createNewExecution chasm_engine.go:156 Builds MutableState in memory (no persistence read)
shardContext.CreateWorkflowExecution context_impl.go:569 Acquires shard lock, assigns rangeID
sqlExecutionStore.CreateWorkflowExecution sql/execution.go:60 Appends history nodes, then TX:
lockCurrentExecutionIfExists execution_util.go:575 SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on current_executions ⨝ executions Key: {shardID, nsID, workflowID, archetypeID}
currentRow == nil -> proceed (no conflict) currentRow != nil -> CurrentWorkflowConditionFailedError (carries existing RunID + RequestIDs)
handleExecutionConflict chasm_engine.go:902 Checks requestID idempotency, then applies reuse/conflict policy
GetChasmLeaseWithConsistencyCheck consistency_checker.go:164 WorkflowKey has RunID set
GetOrCreateChasmExecution cache.go:216 RunID is non-empty -> skip GetCurrentRunID persistence lookup (validateWorkflowExecutionInfo:412-427)
MutableState already loaded -> return from memory
